title: Native release authorization preparation v1
description: Exact read-only preparation body, authenticated by the existing responseSignature/v3 contract over this body and its original timestamp. Shape is not authority. Runtime joins actual principal/route/policy/request/operation, verifies the independent CP key and original deadline, and compares approverPolicySha256 to SHA256 of compact sorted ensure_ascii=True JSON of approverPolicy including null. No new time allowance. Null is allowed only for a genuinely non-JIT route. The native normalized policy is at most 64 KiB after ASCII escaping.

principalId.description: Native principal: runtime additionally requires trim-stable UTF-8 of at most 1024 bytes, with no control characters.

routeId.description: Unchanged legacy route scalar: runtime requires trim-stable UTF-8 of at most 256 bytes, with no U+0000..001F or U+007F. No new ASCII-only alphabet.

normalizedText512.description: Runtime requires nonempty Python-strip-stable UTF-8 of at most 512 bytes; no extra alphabet or blanket control-character rule is imposed.

normalizedText64.description: Runtime requires nonempty Python-strip-stable UTF-8 of at most 64 bytes.

normalizedText128.description: Runtime requires nonempty Python-strip-stable UTF-8 of at most 128 bytes.

normalizedApproverPolicy.description: Exact CP-normalized top-level eight fields and credential twelve fields; all text arrays must be strictly sorted and unique. Entire compact ensure_ascii encoding is <=65536 bytes, including DEL and supplementary-character escaping. Shape alone does not establish actual route restrictions, configured RP/origin, credential currentness, role/trust admission or approval. Actual route JIT additionally requires its exact users/quorum/authenticator/hardware restrictions, requiredRoles=['approver'] and allowAnyApproverId=false.

else.description: Runtime also requires threshold <= the exact allowedApproverIds length.

minimumTrustBundleSequence.description: Explicit new-native bound; legacy normalization is unchanged.

rpId.description: Exact deployment value authenticated by preparation; this shape adds no URL, nonempty or DNS restriction.

origins.description: Singleton exact configured origin; provenance/currentness are not shape checks.
